newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian shares dull, Rakvere, Uhis in focus.
newsitem.headline: Estonian shares dull, Rakvere, Uhis in focus.

text.p: Rakvere and Uhispank were the sole items of interest on a dormant Estonian bourse on Tuesday, where volume totalled 13.5 million kroons and the Talse index rose 0.01 percent to 249.04.
"The bourse was slow with no clear movement during the day,the selling interest in Rakvere held some of the scant attention," one dealer said.
"We are waiting for the market to get a push, but it seemswe will have to wait until the half year results," he added.
Rakvere dropped from 14.35 kroons on Mondayto 13.70 kroons on trade of two million kroons after it reported a 7.9 million kroon loss in the first quarter of 1997.
However, it said that it remained on target for its 1997 profit estimates.
"Brokers and analysts are divided on how to call Rakvere because the first quarter was a loss but some are saying that its profit target is still within reach," one trader said.
The free market turned over 5.7 million kroons with Rakvere the most active stock.
Uhispank was most active stock on the main list with 3.7 million kroons turned over for a gain of 0.20 kroons to 52.35.
"The interest in Uhispank must be foreign, although it is not coming from Helsinki, one trader said.
The shares are also quoted on the Helsinki bourse, where they were at 19.80 markka versus 20 markka.
"There is no reason to out-perform the market," he added.
